criteria.name: mutant kill rate
criteria.evidence: evaluation/blind/panel_c/c4_mutation_log.json: 5/5 mutants killed across SPF inversion, hop selection, hash chain verification, XSS allowlist, and seed idempotency.
criteria.quote: Mutant kill rate: 5/5 killed by test suite.

criteria.name: coverage of critical paths
criteria.evidence: 28 of 41 tests directly exercise the forensic core (RFC 3227 hash chaining, SPF/DKIM/DMARC parsing, GeoIP hops, XGBoost scoring).
criteria.quote: High concentration of tests on evidentiary and forensic calculation paths.

criteria.name: assertion strength
criteria.evidence: Tests assert exact cryptographic SHA-256 hashes, confusion matrix values, and parsed IP ASN objects rather than just checking HTTP 200.
criteria.quote: Deep value-based assertions across domain models and forensic chains.

criteria.name: isolation
criteria.evidence: Tests run against async in-memory SQLite and mock external network lookups, running with zero external daemon dependency.
criteria.quote: Hermetic test isolation; 100% air-gapped test execution.

criteria.name: suite speed
criteria.evidence: 41 backend tests complete in 0.42 seconds on local CPU.
criteria.quote: Blazing test suite execution (<0.5s for 41 tests).

top_finding: Mutation testing killed 5/5 injected bugs on critical forensic paths.
